criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Death Count Inquiries
categories.definition: User intent expresses curiosity about the number of deaths related to COVID-19 in specific regions.

categories.name: General Information Seeking
categories.definition: User intent seeks general information or updates about COVID-19.

categories.name: Gratitude and Appreciation
categories.definition: User expresses gratitude or appreciation towards COVID-19 information sources or assistance received.

categories.name: Prevention and Safety Measures
categories.definition: User intent focuses on ways to prevent infection and ensure safety from COVID-19.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User intent involves questioning or debunking myths and misinformation related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel-related Inquiries
categories.definition: User intent pertains to travel-related queries and concerns in the context of COVID-19.

categories.name: Medical Treatment and Symptoms
categories.definition: User intent seeks information on medical treatment options, symptoms, and remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Contributions
categories.definition: User intent involves donating money or resources to COVID-19 relief efforts or research.

categories.name: Animal-related Concerns
categories.definition: User intent focuses on questions or worries related to animals and COVID-19 transmission.

categories.name: Community Spread and Risk Areas
categories.definition: User intent seeks information on community spread, high-risk areas, and specific locations affected by COVID-19.
